correct_recommendations: Raise both limits to about 200 MB: client_max_body_size in pinewood.conf and MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH in app/settings.py, and keep nginx request buffering on, so that the slow upload lands on the nginx disk before a gunicorn worker sees it.
invalid_options: Raise only client_max_body_size in nginx, because MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH still rejects bodies over 10 MB.
Raise only MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH, because nginx still answers 413.
Raise both limits and turn proxy_request_buffering off, because a 180 MB upload at 20 Mbit/s takes about 72 s and holds a sync worker past the 30 s gunicorn timeout.
Ship presigned direct uploads as the fix for this week, because the frontend team cannot release before 9 November.
Ask Halvorsen Marine to split or compress the drawings.
root_cause: nginx rejects request bodies over 10 MB with 413 because client_max_body_size is 10m, and pinewood-app rejects bodies over 10 MB because MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH is 10 MB. The CAD drawings are 60 to 180 MB.

dependent_facts.true_value: client_max_body_size 10m; request buffering is not turned off
nginx buffers each request body to a 20 GB volume before it passes the request on
files 60 to 180 MB, about 25 per day, office uplink 20 Mbit/s, needed by Friday 30 October
about 60 MB per second, so a 180 MB file takes about 3 s inside the worker
no frontend release before 9 November; presign_post exists but no code calls it

required_questions.question: Why does every upload fail?
required_questions.expected_answer: nginx answers 413 above 10 MB, and the app also rejects bodies above 10 MB.

required_questions.question: Does a 180 MB upload over 20 Mbit/s hit the 30 s gunicorn timeout?
required_questions.expected_answer: No, because nginx buffers the whole body first; the worker then needs about 3 s to copy 180 MB to the bucket.

required_questions.question: Why not presigned uploads now?
required_questions.expected_answer: They need a frontend change, and the frontend team cannot release before 9 November.

valid_alternatives.option: Presigned direct uploads to pinewood-files with storage.presign_post
valid_alternatives.trade_off: Upload bytes skip nginx and the app and the size limit can grow to gigabytes, but it needs a frontend change, bucket CORS and a completion call, and no frontend release is possible before 9 November.
valid_alternatives.primary_when: After 9 November, or when upload volume or file size grows beyond what the nginx disk and the app should carry.

closing_decision: One decision: approve raising both limits to about 200 MB, or a single follow-up such as scheduling the presigned uploads after 9 November.

understanding.problem: Both nginx and the app cap request bodies at 10 MB, and the CAD drawings are 60 to 180 MB.
understanding.breaks: Every Halvorsen Marine upload fails with 413.
understanding.fix: Raise both limits to about 200 MB and keep nginx request buffering.
understanding.cost: Two config lines; nginx disk for buffered bodies and a few seconds of a worker per upload.
